facades.name: domitroviceva_s
facades.source: Street View Jul 2024 (pano 2 Kaptol), frame h38: Domitrovićeva kula (its south half, unrolled)
facades.look: round rubble-stone tower of the Kaptol walls, drawn unrolled: ochre/brown/grey rubble in lime mortar, one small stone-framed window, a tiny window, a hole; a plain eaves course. No text.

facades.name: domitroviceva_n
facades.source: Twin of domitroviceva_s (the north half, facing Ribnjak park: no photo of it)

facades.name: kaptol_wall_w
facades.source: Street View Jul 2024 (pano 2 Kaptol), frames h38 / h40: the Kaptol north wall between Domitrovićeva kula and the Cathedral
facades.look: rough rubble-stone town wall with a stone coping, no openings; containers, cars, fences, the tree and the Gothic pinnacle in front removed.

facades.name: kaptol_wall_e
facades.source: Behind the Cathedral's north fence: very low-res (1/10) twin of kaptol_wall_w (the same rubble wall, frame h105 shows it over the lean-to)

facades.name: ribnjak_tower
facades.source: INVENTED from Domitrovićeva kula's picture (darkened): the round tower on the wall behind the Cathedral, seen from the square over the wall (frame h105) and from Ribnjak park (no photo)

facades.name: nebojan_w
facades.source: Street View Jul 2024 (pano 2 Kaptol), frame h152: Kula Nebojan, its square-facing half unrolled; the lower third is the stone plinth below the square
facades.look: round tower, white lime plaster over a stone plinth, a moulded band, one window with an ornate white stucco frame, a small square opening; eaves cornice. No text.

facades.name: nebojan_s
facades.source: Twin of nebojan_w (its south half, over the park: no photo of it)

facades.name: muzej_west
facades.source: Street View Jul 2024 (pano 2 Kaptol), frame h145: the museum building (Muzej bl. Alojzija Stepinca) facing the square; the lower third is the basement below the square
facades.look: white baroque front: three round-arched ground-floor windows with green fanlights, a loggia of three arches boarded with plywood (2024), pilasters, cornice. No text.

facades.name: muzej_north
facades.source: Street View Jul 2024 (pano 2 Kaptol), frames h105 / h145 (seen obliquely, partly hidden by scaffolding): the museum's side facing the Cathedral front
facades.look: white baroque side: arched ground-floor windows with green fanlights, boarded arched loggia openings above, pilasters.

facades.name: palace_notch_e6
facades.source: INVENTED: the palace wall in the nook between the museum and the Cathedral's south tower (hidden by scaffolding in every 2024 frame)
facades.look: white baroque palace wall with a carriage gateway, windows with green shutters.

facades.name: palace_notch_e7
facades.source: INVENTED: a 4.6 m slice of palace_notch_e6's picture (the nook's short east-facing wall)
